query_reviews.note: 连续产量+0-1启停决策=MIP；LP松弛作基线合理；QP为可信HN，场景无二次项。
Continuous quantities+binary opening=MIP; LP relaxation as bound baseline correct; QP is credible HN.
最小站点覆盖服务半径=Covering Models；IP给出二值规划形式合理；MST为可信HN（连接≠覆盖）。
Set covering over service radius=Covering Models; IP as binary formulation correct; MST credible HN.
恰好访问一次+最短回路=TSP；Hamiltonian Cycle作可行结构补充合理；Shortest Path为可信HN（不遍历所有点）。
Min-cost tour through all vertices=TSP; Hamiltonian cycle as structural companion correct; Shortest Path credible HN.
传感器连通+可选中继点=Steiner Tree；MST作上界基线合理；Matching为可信HN（不构建连通网络）。
Terminal connection+optional relays=Steiner Tree; MST as upper-bound baseline correct; Matching credible HN.
多仓库调货+容量费用=Network Flow Models；LP作为线性表述合理；Matching为可信HN。
Capacitated min-cost shipping=Network Flow; LP as flow-conservation formulation correct; Matching credible HN.
随机到达+等待拥堵=Queuing Theory；Decision Theory作成本-风险权衡补充合理；Inventory为可信HN。
Random arrivals+congestion=Queuing Theory; Decision Theory for staffing tradeoff correct; Inventory credible HN.
不确定需求+多期订货=Inventory Theory；DP作状态递推合理；Queuing为可信HN（无服务等待场景）。
Uncertain demand+multi-period ordering=Inventory Theory; DP as sequential state recursion correct; Queuing credible HN.
有限健康状态+动作改变转移概率=MDP；DP作Bellman递推合理；Difference Equation为可信HN（无动作依赖）。
Action-dependent stochastic transitions=MDP; DP as Bellman recursion correct; Difference Equation credible HN.
多目标不能合并固定权重=Multi-Objective Programming；Goal Programming作替代方案合理；TOPSIS为可信HN（不优化约束变量）。
Multiple objectives without fixed weighting=Multi-Objective Programming; Goal Programming as alternative correct; TOPSIS credible HN.
先定批发价后确定货量=Multi-level Programming（主从博弈）；Decision Theory作策略不确定性补充合理；AHP为可信HN。
Leader-follower sequential decisions=Multi-level Programming; Decision Theory for response analysis correct; AHP credible HN.
光滑非线性+等式不等式约束+刻画必要条件=KKT Conditions；Lagrange Multiplier作等式约束基础合理；Newton为可信HN（求解器而非必要条件）。
Necessary conditions for smooth constrained problem=KKT; Lagrange Multiplier as equality foundation correct; Newton credible HN.
0-1变量+可证明全局最优+松弛下界剪枝=Branch and Bound；Relaxation提供边界合理；GA为可信HN（不提供最优性证明）。
Binary variables+provable optimum+bound pruning=Branch and Bound; Relaxation for bounds correct; GA credible HN.
记忆近期动作+越过局部最优=Tabu Search；SA作概率跳出替代方案合理；Greedy为可信HN（无可逆且无跳出机制）。
Move memory+escape local optima=Tabu Search; SA as probabilistic escape correct; Greedy credible HN.
无梯度+并行群体+共享历史最优=PSO；GA作群体进化替代合理；Conjugate Gradient为可信HN（需可微结构）。
Derivative-free+parallel population+shared best=PSO; GA as population alternative correct; Conjugate Gradient credible HN.
缺失噪声+非线性交互+缩放不敏感+多弱模型=Random Forest；Boosting作串行集成替代合理；Naive Bayes为可信HN（条件独立冲突）。
Scale-insensitive+weak learners+nonlinear=Random Forest; Boosting as sequential ensemble correct; Naive Bayes credible HN.
少样本高维+最大间隔=SVM；LDA作协方差稳定+线性判别基线合理；Naive Bayes为可信HN。
Scarce labels+high-dim+max-margin=SVM; LDA as stable covariance baseline correct; Naive Bayes credible HN.
已知K+紧凑球形+可扩展中心=K-Means；EM作软分配替代合理；Hierarchical Clustering为可信HN（大样本已知K下不必要）。
Known-k+compact spherical+scalable centroids=K-Means; EM as soft-assignment correct; Hierarchical credible HN.
高维→二维网格+保留邻域拓扑=SOM；Hierarchical Clustering作嵌套结构补充合理；K-Means为可信HN（无拓扑保留）。
2D grid+topology-preserving=SOM; Hierarchical as nested structure correct; K-Means credible HN.
高度共线+近似线性+稳定系数=Ridge Regression；Linear Regression作无正则基线合理；Poisson Regression为可信HN（连续响应非计数）。
Collinear+approximately linear+stabilize=Ridge; Linear Regression as baseline correct; Poisson credible HN.
缓慢变化+无全局函数+附近样本拟合=LWLR；Linear Regression作偏差诊断基线合理；Ridge为可信HN（全局收缩不产生局部适应）。
Smoothly varying+local trends=LWLR; Linear Regression as bias diagnostic correct; Ridge credible HN.
两组高维+最强共同变化+压缩维度=CCA；PCA作单组压缩基线合理；LLE为可信HN（无非线性流形假设）。
Two views+shared variation+dimension reduction=CCA; PCA as per-view compression correct; LLE credible HN.
弯曲低维流形+局部邻域重构=LLE；Laplacian Eigenmaps作图谱映射替代合理；PCA为可信HN（单一线性子空间）。
Curved manifold+local reconstruction=LLE; Laplacian Eigenmaps as graph-spectrum alternative correct; PCA credible HN.
自助样本+并行训练+平均=Bagging；Random Forest作特征随机化精炼合理；Boosting为可信HN（串行残差非并行方差缩减）。
Bootstrap+parallel+average=Bagging; Random Forest as feature-randomized refinement correct; Boosting credible HN.
趋势季节性自相关+月度+离散递推=ARIMA；Difference Equation作递推动态表示合理；Grey Forecasting为可信HN（稀疏不完备数据不适配）。
Trend+seasonality+autocorrelation+monthly=ARIMA; Difference Equation as recurrence correct; Grey credible HN.
均值稳定+波动成簇+条件方差=GARCH；ARIMA作条件均值建模补充合理；Grey Forecasting为可信HN。
Volatility clustering+conditional variance=GARCH; ARIMA for conditional mean correct; Grey credible HN.
人群分舱+传播参数+干预策略=Infectious Disease Model；MDP作分阶段决策优化合理；Population Prediction为可信HN（无传播机制）。
Compartments+transmission+staged interventions=Infectious Disease Model; MDP for sequential decisions correct; Population Prediction credible HN.
河流输运扩散+上游排放+衰减离散求解=River Pollutant Diffusion Model；Difference Equation作有限差分离散合理；Heat Conduction为可信HN（无对流源项）。
Advection-diffusion+decay+discrete solver=River Pollutant Diffusion; Difference Equation as FD discretization correct; Heat Conduction credible HN.
两两比较+一致性检查+正负理想排序=AHP+TOPSIS；Entropy Weighting为可信HN（客观权重与专家判断矛盾）。
Pairwise comparison+consistency+ideal solution ranking=AHP+TOPSIS; Entropy Weighting credible HN.
不采用专家+离散度客观权重+理想距离排序=Entropy Weighting+TOPSIS；AHP为可信HN（主观成对判断矛盾）。
No expert+indicator dispersion+ideal distance=Entropy Weighting+TOPSIS; AHP credible HN.
模糊语言评价+隶属度综合=Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation；AHP作专家层次权重输入合理；DEA为可信HN（效率前沿不处理模糊语义）。
Fuzzy linguistic ratings+membership aggregation=Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation; AHP for expert weights correct; DEA credible HN.
准则依赖反馈+网络结构优先权=ANP；AHP作独立层次基线合理；TOPSIS为可信HN（不推断反馈网络优先权）。
Dependence+feedback+network priorities=ANP; AHP as independence baseline correct; TOPSIS credible HN.
多投入多产出+相对效率+综合排序=DEA+TOPSIS；ANOVA为可信HN（不构造效率前沿）。
Multiple inputs+outputs+efficiency+ordering=DEA+TOPSIS; ANOVA credible HN.
近似正态+近似直线+检验线性相关=Pearson；Linear Regression作预测直线补充合理；Kendall为可信HN（涉及排序非连续变量）。
Approximately normal+linear scatter=Pearson; Linear Regression for predictive line correct; Kendall credible HN.
配对治疗+差值非正态+分布偏离+位置改变=Wilcoxon Signed Rank；KS Test作分布比较补充合理；ANOVA为可信HN（组间均值忽略配对）。
Paired+non-normal+difference shift=Wilcoxon; KS Test for distributional check correct; ANOVA credible HN.
四种工艺+均值比较+残差分布吻合=ANOVA+KS Test；Wilcoxon为可信HN（非配对数据）。
Four groups+mean comparison+residual distribution=ANOVA+KS Test; Wilcoxon credible HN.
分类变量计数比例+连续分布吻合=Chi-Square GOF+KS Test；ANOVA为可信HN（无组间均值比较）。
Categorical counts+proportions+continuous distribution=Chi-Square GOF+KS Test; ANOVA credible HN.
年度年龄组+出生死亡迁移+政策情景递推=Population Prediction Model；Difference Equation作递推表示合理；Infectious Disease为可信HN。
Cohort projection+births+deaths+migration=Population Prediction; Difference Equation as recurrence correct; Infectious Disease credible HN.
资本劳动技术+长期产出+储蓄率增长情景=Economic Growth Model；Difference Equation作资本更新递推合理；Population Prediction为可信HN。
Capital+labour+technology+growth scenarios=Economic Growth; Difference Equation for annual updates correct; Population Prediction credible HN.
细长材料两端温度+时空导数离散=Heat Conduction Model；Difference Equation作有限差分合理；River Pollutant Diffusion为可信HN（无对流源项）。
Transient conductive heat+discretized derivatives=Heat Conduction; Difference Equation as FD stepping correct; River Pollutant credible HN.
双方兵力消耗+分阶段调整+影响最终损失=Battle Model；MDP作序贯决策表述合理；Infectious Disease为可信HN。
Two-force attrition+staged adjustments+final losses=Battle Model; MDP as sequential decision formulation correct; Infectious Disease credible HN.

equivalence_reviews.note: method-0与method-38均为Linear Programming语义重复条目，应合并为一个Retrieval概念。
method-89与method-90描述几乎逐字相同，均通过信息熵确定客观权重，应合并。
